name: Sprocket
text:
Decision: We should auto-apply safe, low-risk improvements to our own codebase (like removing dead code or fixing typos) without waiting for manual review.

Why: It speeds up progress and keeps the code clean with minimal risk. The trade-off is we might miss subtle issues, but we’ll set strict limits (e.g., no logic changes) and log every change for later review. This balances speed and safety.
